name: Harbin Bank Co., Ltd.
summary: Harbin Bank Co., Ltd. provides various banking products and services primarily in China. The company operates through four segments: Corporate Financial Business, Retail Financial Business, Interbank Financial Business, and Other Business. It offers demand and time deposit products; personal savings; personal and collateral loans; corporate deposits and loans, including carbon emission rights pledge, fixed asset, syndicated, working capital, and real estate loans; and SME financial services, as well as bank, debit, and credit cards.
